verdict.rationale: Crossplane's declarative, Kubernetes-native model (CRDs, GitOps workflows, Compositions) implies that many resources can be created/updated/deleted in bulk via standard kubectl/GitOps tooling, and docs mention machine-readable, automation-friendly APIs and drift correction. However, no evidence explicitly documents a bulk-operation feature or workflow (e.g., batch apply across many composite resources, bulk import, mass reconciliation) — missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation tooling/documentation, hands-on demonstration of operating on many resources simultaneously, and independent confirmation of scale behavior.
